title: CASE: Confusion-Aware Skill Evolution for Frozen Multimodal Emotion Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.32481v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have substantially advanced Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) by enabling fine-grained emotion understanding through reasoning over multimodal evidence. However, they still exhibit systematic confusion between semantically adjacent emotions with highly overlapping multimodal cues. Existing approaches typically address these errors through global parameter adaptation, making confusion correction costly and inflexible. We instead observe that emotion confusion is highly localized and therefore better addressed through reusable pair-specific expertise. Building on this insight, we propose Confusion-Aware Skill Evolution (CASE), the first agent-skill framework for MER. CASE maintains a sparse, self-evolving library of pair-specific EmotionSkills that externalize affective expertise from model parameters, enabling the learned expertise to be continuously refined and readily transferred across divers

translated_title: CASE：面向冻结多模态情感模型的混淆感知技能演化
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）通过对多模态证据进行推理，实现了细粒度的情感理解，从而极大地推动了多模态情感识别（MER）的发展。然而，这类模型在语义相近且多模态线索高度重叠的情感之间仍然表现出系统性的混淆。现有方法通常通过全局参数适配来解决这些错误，导致混淆纠正成本高昂且缺乏灵活性。我们转而观察到，情感混淆是高度局部化的现象，因此更适合通过可复用的、针对特定情感对的专业知识来解决。基于这一洞察，我们提出了混淆感知技能演化（CASE），这是首个面向MER的智能体技能框架。CASE维护一个稀疏的、自演化的、针对特定情感对的EmotionSkills库，将情感专业知识从模型参数中外化，使学到的专业知识能够被持续精炼，并易于跨多样场景迁移。
tldr: 提出首个面向多模态情感识别的智能体技能框架CASE，通过维护针对特定情感对的自演化EmotionSkills库，在冻结模型参数的前提下以低成本、可复用、可迁移的方式纠正语义相近情感间的系统性混淆。
en_tdlr: CASE is the first agent-skill framework for multimodal emotion recognition that corrects systematic confusion between semantically adjacent emotions by maintaining a sparse, self-evolving library of pair-specific EmotionSkills, enabling low-cost, reusable, and transferable confusion correction without modifying the frozen model parameters.
